title: Vegapay raises $10M in Series A round co-led by Vertex Ventures, Prosus
summary: Vegapay raised 10 million dollars in Series A funding led by Vertex and Prosus
detailed: Fintech infrastructure startup Vegapay has raised $10 million in a Series A funding round co-led by Vertex Ventures Southeast Asia & India and Prosus, as it looks to expand its credit infrastructure offerings for banks and financial institutions.
Founded in 2022 by Gaurav Mittal, Himanshu Agrawal and Puneet Sharma, Vegapay provides an issuer processing and credit lifecycle management platform for Credit Line on UPI (CLOU) and credit cards.

sentences: Fintech infrastructure startup Vegapay has raised $10 million in a Series A funding round co-led by Vertex Ventures Southeast Asia & India and Prosus, as it looks to expand its credit infrastructure offerings for banks and financial institutions.
The round also saw participation from existing investors Elevation Capital and Eximius Ventures.
It comprised primary and secondary components, with more than 40 employees getting an opportunity to sell a portion of their vested employee stock ownership plans (ESOPs).
Founded in 2022 by Gaurav Mittal, Himanshu Agrawal and Puneet Sharma, Vegapay provides an issuer processing and credit lifecycle management platform for Credit Line on UPI (CLOU) and credit cards.

The company will use the fresh capital to onboard more banks onto its Credit Line on UPI platform, introduce secured credit lines backed by fixed deposits, gold and mutual funds, and expand its credit card, prepaid card and forex card programmes.
It also plans to strengthen its engineering and risk teams.
As of November 2026, Vegapay claims to command a majority share of India's Credit Line on UPI market.

Its platform is live with YES BANK, Unity Small Finance Bank, Suryoday Small Finance Bank and BOBCARD, and powers programmes for Paytm, BharatPe, Kiwi UPI, Scapia and EbixCash World Money, among others.
Vegapay's platform covers the entire credit lifecycle, including customer onboarding, underwriting, real-time authorisation, billing, repayments and reconciliation.
It allows banks to operate multiple co-branded credit programmes on a single platform, with individual credit limits, pricing structures and rules.
Banks can deploy the platform on their own cloud infrastructure or on-premises.
Credit Line on UPI is the UPI moment for credit, and banks should lead it.
At Vegapay, we are building the infrastructure layer that banks need.

It runs the full credit line lifecycle for the bank, the bank keeps the customer and the credit book, and one platform can run many co-brand programmes, each with its own limits, pricing and rules,” said Gaurav Mittal, Co-founder and CEO of Vegapay.

Nikhil Marwaha, Partner at Vertex Ventures Southeast Asia & India, said the adoption of credit on UPI could reshape India's lending landscape, adding that Vegapay's platform enables banks to move from product development to launch within weeks.
Credit Line on UPI allows banks to offer customers pre-sanctioned credit lines that can be used at UPI QR codes through existing payment applications, without requiring a separate card or app.
The model is expected to expand access to formal credit by leveraging India's existing digital payments infrastructure.
